title: 店里来了一只猫 Diàn lǐ lái le yì zhī māo — The cat that moved in
summary: A cat walks into a fruit stall and quietly changes the everyday life of the whole street.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 一天，门口来了一只小猫。
body.py: yì tiān, ménkǒu lái le yì zhī xiǎo māo.
body.en: One day a small cat comes to his door.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: nǐ è le ma? chī diǎn ba.
body.en: Are you hungry? Have something to eat.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 猫没有走，第二天又来了。
body.py: māo méiyǒu zǒu, dì èr tiān yòu lái le.
body.en: The cat does not leave and comes again the next day.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā zuò zài píngguǒ kuāng pángbiān.
body.en: It sits beside the apple crate.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: tā bǐ wǒ de shōuyīnjī hái máng.
body.en: It is busier than my radio.

body.speaker: 顾客
body.py: dàye, zhè zhī māo shì nǐ de ma?

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: bú shì. tā zìjǐ lái de.
body.en: No. It came on its own.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 猫天天来，还带来两只小鸟。
body.py: māo tiāntiān lái, hái dàilái liǎng zhī xiǎo niǎo.
body.en: The cat comes every day and brings two small birds.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: niǎo bù néng gěi nǐ, fàng le tāmen.
body.en: You cannot keep the birds, let them go.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: nǐ tiāntiān lái, jiù shì wǒ de rén.
body.en: If you come every day, you are one of my people.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 它一来，摊子前就热闹了。
body.py: tā yì lái, tānzi qián jiù rènao le.
body.en: As soon as it arrives, the stall becomes lively.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: māo zǒng shì zuò zài zuì qiánmian.
body.en: The cat always sits at the very front.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: tā bǐ wǒ de shuǐguǒ hái zhòngyào.
body.en: It matters even more to me than my fruit.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 后来街上的人都认识它。
body.py: hòulái jiē shàng de rén dōu rènshi tā.
body.en: Later everybody on the street knew it.

body.speaker: 李大爷
body.py: zhè zhī māo bǐ wǒ huì zuò shēngyi.
body.en: This cat is better at business than I am.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 做生意 zuò shēngyi — to do business
放了 fàng le — to let go
认识 rènshi — to know (a face or a place)

blocks.body: Think about it: What two animals does the story mention, and why do people start calling the shop by a new name?
